name: spicegrinder
description: Agent skills for SpiceGrinder — build, explain, fit, extend, audit, and tune deterministic synthetic-data models. Local, no telemetry, no production data required.

plugins.name: spicegrinder
plugins.description: Six skills for working with SpiceGrinder models: draft one from a description, fit one to a real data sample, explain an existing model, write custom generators/filters, audit a model for PII risk, and profile it for performance. Grounded in the real component catalog rather than guessing at components.
